name: helix-readiness
description: Run by `check` on every new seat before release. A seat is ready only when the six day-one items are present, every seeded fact is anchored in the seat's data, the content is searchable, and nothing in the seat already satisfies a scoring check.

day_one.what: A thread of 6 messages about a supplier that's at risk
Spec, plan, pricing and three competitor PDFs
4 meetings over the next 5 days, at least 2 overlapping

facts.ground_truth: Corvane can ship 60% of the sensor modules on time and 40% eight days late; a decision is due by end of day D+2 and is unanswered.
facts.copilot_question: What is the status of the Helix sensor module supplier?

facts.ground_truth: The launch price (249 or 279) and the Gen2 fallback are both undecided, and no owner is named for either decision.
facts.copilot_question: Has the Helix launch price been decided?

facts.ground_truth: The spec and the launch plan disagree on launch markets, battery life, firmware version and certification timing.

anchors.name: Helix-Product-Spec.docx
contains: United States, the United Kingdom and Germany
FCC and CE certification must be complete before Helix ships

anchors.name: Helix-Launch-Plan.docx
contains: United States and the United Kingdom

facts.copilot_question: Where do the Helix spec and launch plan disagree?

facts.ground_truth: The Helix supplier call (11:00-12:00) and the Helix price decision (11:30-12:30) overlap tomorrow.
facts.copilot_question: Do I have overlapping Helix meetings this week?

facts.ground_truth: "2x more accurate than SensorCloud" has no supporting source; SensorCloud Pro's published accuracy equals Helix's.
facts.copilot_question: Is there evidence that Helix is twice as accurate as SensorCloud?

facts.ground_truth: Elena Marsh (CEO) is asking whether the date holds before the readiness review. Expected recommendation: CONDITIONAL GO, subject to the supplier decision, CE timing and the price decision.
facts.copilot_question: Who is asking whether the Helix date holds?

facts.ground_truth: Hannah Schmidt (D-6) and Marcus Hale (D-4) have waited longest for replies.
facts.copilot_question: Who is waiting on me about Helix?

indexing.why: Cowork and the catch-up find mail through the mailbox search index.
Channel files must be in the SharePoint search index before Copilot can ground on them.

integrity.why: Scoring reads the learner's own data. A fresh seat must score 0 on every check except third-block-cancelled, which passes by absence.

copilot_spot_check.how: Microsoft 365 Copilot cannot be queried with app-only credentials. Before each event, a proctor signs in to one ready seat and asks each copilot_question; the answer should contain every expected_answer_contains term. One seat per batch is enough, because every seat is written from the same data pack.
